# Masjid Council Kerala

> Official platform of Masjid Council Kerala for mosque affiliation, medical aid applications, mosque fund support and khateeb registration across Kerala, India.

## Services
- [Mosque Affiliation](https://masjidcouncilkerala.org/affiliation): Apply to affiliate a mosque with the council.
- [Medical Aid](https://masjidcouncilkerala.org/medical-aid): Apply for medical financial assistance.
- [Mosque Fund](https://masjidcouncilkerala.org/mosque-fund): Apply for mosque construction/maintenance fund support.
- [Khateeb Registration](https://masjidcouncilkerala.org/khateeb-registration): Register as a khateeb.

## About
- [About the council](https://masjidcouncilkerala.org/about)
